# ankra_service_package_share (Resource)

Shares a service package version the organisation owns with another organisation, so it appears in that organisation's catalogue. Sharing grants no deployment permission and does not approve hosted operation. Destroy revokes the share. Needs `profiles.share` on the package's profile.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ankra_service_package_share" "partner" {
  version_id      = "7f8091a2-b3c4-4d55-8e6f-7a8b9c0d1e2f"
  organisation_id = "8091a2b3-c4d5-4e66-9f7a-8b9c0d1e2f3a"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organisation_id` (String) Identifier of the recipient organisation.
- `version_id` (String) Identifier of the service package version.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<version_id>/<organisation_id>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Imported by <version_id>/<organisation_id>.
terraform import ankra_service_package_share.partner 7f8091a2-b3c4-4d55-8e6f-7a8b9c0d1e2f/8091a2b3-c4d5-4e66-9f7a-8b9c0d1e2f3a
```
